deleteUser.metaTitle: How to Delete Your User - T Labs
deleteUser.metaDescription: Learn how to delete your account and all associated data from the T Labs purchasing inventory app.
deleteUser.title: How to Delete Your User
deleteUser.subtitle: We respect your right to privacy. Here's how you can request deletion of your account and all associated data from our purchasing inventory app.
deleteUser.cancelPlanDescription: Before deleting your account, you must cancel your active payment plan. Go to Configurações (Settings) in the mobile app and cancel your subscription under the payment section. Account deletion will not be possible while you have an active plan.
deleteUser.step1Description: Open the mobile application and navigate to Configurações (Settings). You can find it in the bottom menu or the side navigation panel.
deleteUser.step2Description: Inside Configurações, locate and press the "Delete Account" button. You will be asked to confirm your decision before proceeding.
deleteUser.step3Title: We verify and process your request
deleteUser.step3Description: For your security, the app will confirm your identity before processing the deletion. You may be asked to re-enter your credentials to proceed.
deleteUser.step4Description: Once verified, we will permanently delete your account and all associated data, including purchasing history, inventory records, and personal information. This action cannot be undone.
deleteUser.timelineTitle: Your request will be processed within 7 business days
deleteUser.timelineDescription: You will receive a confirmation email once your data has been fully deleted. During this period, your account may be deactivated while deletion is being processed.
deleteUser.privacyDescription: We are committed to protecting your personal data. We do not sell or share your information with third parties. Once deletion is complete, your data is permanently removed from our systems and cannot be recovered.

hero.title: Your pantry,
hero.subtitle: Scan your grocery receipt and the app builds your inventory, shows where the money went and reminds you what is running out. Let us handle it — we'll remind you what to buy.

problem.title: Big cart, short memory.
problem.subtitle: Same scene every month: the cart fills up, the receipt disappears into the bag and nobody knows what is already at home.
problem.item1Title: You buy what you already had
problem.item1Desc: Three jars of oregano in the pantry and no rice. Without a real inventory, the shopping list is guesswork.
problem.item2Desc: With no categories, there is no way to tell how much went to meat, cleaning or drinks — or where you could have cut back.
problem.item3Desc: Figuring out what to cook every night costs more time and energy than the cooking itself.

scan.title: Point it at the receipt. The app takes it from there.
scan.description: Scan the receipt QR code or photograph the printed slip. The shopping assistant reads the electronic document and returns every line item with quantity, unit and price — no typing.
scan.b1: Reads the electronic consumer invoice (NFC-e) directly.
scan.b2: Product, unit, quantity and price extracted automatically.
scan.b3: Sensitive receipt data is not stored.

inventory.title: Everything you own, counted.
inventory.description: Every purchase feeds your household stock. Sort by product or by quantity, see what is running low and never bring home a fifth bag of coffee again.
inventory.b1: Product list with quantities in units, grams or kilos.
inventory.b2: Search and sorting by name or remaining quantity.
inventory.b3: Dashboard with spending history per purchase and category.

checklist.title: A list that builds itself.
checklist.description: Pick what is missing or ask the AI for a suggestion: describe the context — barbecue this weekend, focus on vegetables, cleaning supplies — and the list comes back ready and organized.
checklist.b1: AI suggestions based on your history and your instructions.
checklist.b2: Double tap a product to adjust quantity and weight.
checklist.b3: Items grouped by category: produce, dry goods, meat, drinks.

planner.title: Seven days of meals in one tap.
planner.description: The Meal Planner builds the week's menu from what is already in your pantry and tracks how your Nutrition Score evolves over time.
planner.b1: Generate 7 days of meals with a single button.
planner.b2: Free-form instructions for the AI, like "more vegetables, no fried food".
planner.b3: Nutrition Score history to follow your progress.

spending.title: Where the grocery money went.
spending.description: Each statement shows the total spent in the period plus AI-generated categories. Pick a date, open a category and see item by item what pushed the bill up.
spending.b1: Total spent per purchase, per day and per period.
spending.b2: Categories created by AI from the receipt line items.

modules.title: From cart to checkout.
modules.subtitle: Purchasing Inventory brings inventory, lists, meal planning and spending control together in one place — no spreadsheet, no paper.
modules.f1Desc: Spending overview per period, filtered by category.
modules.f2Desc: Your household inventory, kept up to date by your receipts.
modules.f3Desc: A weekly menu built from what you already have.
modules.f4Desc: Named shopping lists you can reuse and share.
modules.f5Desc: Your plan and charges gathered on a single screen.
modules.f6Desc: Tell us what you want in the app and follow its development in a kanban board.
